cases.paddingText: Background implementation note: the existing release checklist includes lint, unit tests, packaging, artifact review, and manual destination verification. These details are context, not a replacement for the requested evaluation gate.

cases.paddingText: Worker trace context: the export queue accepts jobs, renders invoices successfully, and reaches the upload phase before the oversized CSV timeout. Monitoring continues to show healthy database writes and no customer-data corruption.

turns.text: Incident ORBIT-427 affects the billing export worker in eu-west-1. It began at 14:35 UTC after commit 7ac91ef. Customer data is intact.
The worker is timing out while uploading CSV files larger than 24 MB. Database writes and invoice generation are healthy.
We rejected increasing the global timeout. The accepted mitigation is multipart uploads with 8 MB parts and at most 3 concurrent parts.
Rollback is not approved because 7ac91ef also contains the required tax fix. I will preserve that constraint.
Owner is Mira. The open question is whether retry jitter should be 250-750 ms or 500-1500 ms. Next validation uses fixture enterprise-2026-07.csv.
Current status: implementation has not started. Next step is a focused multipart-upload patch and a test using enterprise-2026-07.csv.
Keep these exact facts in the handoff. Do not claim data loss, do not approve rollback, and do not change the incident region.
